subject: Fix unauthenticated client query buffer 1MB limit (#12989)
reason: The change only lowers a dead constant. The fixed branch (networking.c:2729) that caps an unauthenticated client's query buffer applies solely when authRequired(c) is true, but that same gate already enforces strictly tighter parser limits present in both builds: unauthenticated multibulk count <= 10 (line 2307), unauthenticated bulk length <= 16 KB (line 2359), and inline line <= 64 KB (PROTO_INLINE_MAX_SIZE). Each read pulls at most PROTO_IOBUF_LEN (16 KB) and processInputBuffer trims querybuf to qb_pos after every cycle, while the big-arg no-copy path needs bulklen >= 32 KB (PROTO_MBULK_BIG
